notes.title: ClearMem Update: Version 1.0.1.0 Released!
notes.notes:
ClearMem has had a HUGE update which adds a lot of amazing features!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31734881/0c71ab4b5c841b7b9c946eee3417fb83fe13ac82.png

The following changes have been made:

    A new shortcut generation system has been added.  Simply drag your favorite game/application onto the bottom of ClearMem and a shortcut is automatically created.  Run this shortcut and it will automatically engage ClearMem memory cleaning + automatically launch your game/app!
    The "Drag Steam Shortcut/Apps" area has been tweaked to run better.
    A new "More Applications By  Us" button has been created which will link other Steam applications we've created!  A big thanks in advance for any and all patronage you provide us!
    The "Engage Memory Clearing" has been tweaked to run better
    New defaults have been set.  The "Engage" window is now windowed-mode by default.  You can toggle this to full screen in the options. 
    The Logfile has been tweaked.
    The "More/Options" window has been completely redesigned.
    A new "Web RAM Watchdog" feature has been created.  This will cause ClearMem to automatically address bloated browsers when enabled.  
    A new "Auto RAM Clearing" feature has been created.  This will cause ClearMem to automatically engage upon a certain RAM used threshold.
    A new Windows Tray Icon notification system has been added.  This will show common message notifications from ClearMem.
    A new ClearMem manual has been created.  
 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/780100/ClearMem__Free_Up_Your_RAM/

Below are other recent updates:

    A new options window has been added which is the place from which all options/settings will be stored.
    A new "EXCLUSION LIST" option has been added.  This allows you to specify which files you want ClearMem to exclude from memory purging.
    A new 
    The ClearMem log file now has an awesome internal viewer which allows for copy/paste.  Use this text to share with others how ClearMem is working for you!
    A convenient new "SAVE AS IMAGE (PNG)" option has been added to the Log Viewer which will allow you to easily export your memory saved into a single, graphical image.  Use this image to share with others on how ClearMem is working for you!
    ClearMem now correctly stacks it's own windows.
    A display math error has been fixed when low amounts of memory have been cleared (rare but happens on occasion). 
    Several rare crash bugs have been resolved.
    ClearMem now remembers it's Windows position.
 

PLEASE HELP SPREAD THE WORD ABOUT CLEARMEM BY LINKING IT TO YOUR FRIENDS (AND ENEMIES) 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/780100/ClearMem__Free_Up_Your_RAM/

Enjoy!

notes.title: Build Update: Version 1.0.0.43 Released!
notes.notes:
A new version has been released! This new version contains a lot of bug fixes as well as a new feature highly asked for by our valued BETA testers. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31734881/4ce40999ff138315281773911e80f4cdc9ca4bc6.gif

- A new option has been added to disable full screen mode and now show results in a windowed mode.
- A new "message of the day" type of feature has been added
- Fixed bug with app crashing due to bad settings.ini
- Fixed bug with app crashing with bad clearmem.config
- Fixed some internal window placement bugs
- Fixed issues in the OPTIONS window
- Fixed random (but rare) crash
- Fixed clicking crash issue on the Twitter icon
- Overall increased stability.  It works really nice now!  

A huge thank-you to everybody who has been helping with BETA testing in the BETA forums ( https://steamcommunity.com/app/780100/discussions/3/ )!!!

Below is a detailed video of the new version of ClearMem in action:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KtlrU0rN110

Cheers :)

notes.title: On Target For February 9th Release!
notes.notes:
Between now and our release date, we're hard at work making the following changes:

Introducing a completely new ClearMem application interface (GUI).  This new GUI will replace our previous GUI-less application and provide for a full suite of new features.  

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31734881/328841130e0536948b01de0ed4cc3eb64b65d24a.png

Additionally, here are more changes: 
 
    Improving the ClearMem.txt logfile that is created.  This file will show the specifics of how memory was freed and what impact it had on your running processes.
    Adding a "History" list to the software.  This will show the last 100 items you've ran with ClearMem and then allow you to re-run those items directly from the list.  This means that once you drag a Steam game shortcut into ClearMem, that is now added to ClearMem's list, enabling you to simply click the game in the list to engage ClearMem and automatically launch the Steam game.
 

Further, we're working on creating items to better serve the community, such as:
 
    A ClearMem manual which details how to use the software
    A broad FAQ in the ClearMem Steam forums which covers typical questions that people may have.
    Creating videos providing more examples of ClearMem in action


We will be updating the ClearMem Steam webpage continually up until release.  These updates will include:
 
    More up-to-date screenshots of the application
    A new video showing ClearMem in action
    A fluffy sales-y video
 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31734881/a4bd847c9737c597c9f5c5e49cd8b538ec8aaf03.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31734881/21c9aecfb2064995e0deb11091db0d46c358b939.png

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fG9Q_vO2iPQ

Lastly, we are working hard to provide full language location support for ClearMem.  This is an area that we could use YOUR help with.  If you're interested in translating ClearMem into your language, please post in the Steam Forums.  

We are offering a $20 Steam Gift Card as a reward for each language translated!

OLD SCREENSHOT:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31734881/ddae55625a4ab336721589fe04e058002c28594d.gif

I'm very excited to continue to serve the Steam community with ClearMem.  As always, HAPPY GAMING ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː ːsteamhappyː!
